name: Modern
description: Clean lines, uncluttered surfaces, and a neutral base punctuated by bold accents.

name: Minimalist
description: Pared-back interiors that favor function, negative space, and a restrained palette.

name: Scandinavian
description: Light, airy, and cozy, blending natural wood tones with soft textiles and simple forms.

name: Industrial
description: Exposed structural elements, raw textures, and utilitarian furniture with a warehouse feel.

name: Japandi
description: A fusion of Japanese minimalism and Scandinavian warmth, favoring calm, natural materials.

name: Traditional
description: Classic silhouettes, rich wood tones, and layered, formal detailing.

name: Contemporary
description: A current, ever-evolving mix of clean forms, curated texture, and confident neutrals.

name: Luxury
description: Elevated materials, tailored detailing, and a refined, high-end finish throughout.

name: Bohemian
description: Layered textiles, eclectic patterns, and a warm, collected-over-time character.

name: Mid-Century Modern
description: Organic curves, tapered legs, and a warm mix of wood tones with bold accent colors.

name: Rustic
description: Natural, weathered textures and a warm, cabin-inspired sense of comfort.

name: Coastal
description: Breezy, light-filled interiors inspired by seaside living and natural textures.

name: Classic
description: Timeless proportions and refined detailing that resist passing trends.

name: Eclectic
description: A confident, curated mix of eras, patterns, and materials unified by intention.

name: Custom
description: A style defined entirely by your own description, blending influences as you choose.
